purpose: ownership note: book of vipra Gaṅgādhararāja
notes: The scribe is from Vidyāpīṭha ("vidyāpīṭhayā", Newari genitive). This is a place name (a locality in the Kathmandu Valley), not necessarily where the copy was made, so place of copying is left empty. The ownership statement ("eyācchayā (?) vipraśrīgaṃgā[dha]rarājasya pustakam idaṃ") comes after the scribal colophon and may be a later owner's note. Because of that, no wrote_for relation is asserted. "eyācchayā" is unclear: it may be a corrupt word or part of a name. The letters "dha" in Gaṅgādhara are supplied by the cataloguer. The scribe's name agrees with the catalogue field "Jayasiṃkarmmācārya" once normalized to Jayasiṃha with the title karmācārya. Date NS 799 = c. 1679 CE.
